notes:
Context: SignalCare is an omnichannel ecommerce CX operator (app + web + email). Primary goal is faster TTR and lower triage cost via automated summarization + tags that drive Zendesk macros.

- Quote from CCO on 2026-03-01 call: "If we can reliably get a concise 2-3 line summary + 3 suggested tags per ticket, we save ~30-40% triage time."
- Volume: avg 5k tickets/day, peak 20k/day during promos (Black Friday-like spikes). Current latency pain: slow bulk tagging, Zendesk macros manual.
- Preference: Dedicated pool in VPC for predictability and data isolation; fallback to hosted during non-sensitive workloads.
- Integrations: Zendesk (primary), small Freshdesk sandbox for a subset of brands; want API-based tag injection & macro triggers; field mapping required for ~12 custom fields.
- Security: must support SSO (SAML), audit logs, KMS-managed keys, and data residency in NA. Will need SOC2 report and ISO27001 if available.
- Cost sensitivity: mid — willing to commit for predictable latency but want Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization to reduce token costs.
- Acceptance criteria for POC: 90%+ tag accuracy (editor review), median summarization length 20-35 words, end-to-end tagging latency under 800ms at baseline, maintain <2s median under 3x baseline spike.
- Sticking points: mapping messy legacy custom fields; legal wants retention controls before Prod.
- Artifacts: POC deck and initial field mapping spreadsheet in Drive, security questionnaire in thread above.
